$comment: #954: where the walkthrough verifies each fix. Keyed by issue number (preferred) or PR number. wave: A-G or BA; phase: a TEST_PLAN.md phase ("8", "S21") or journey step ("J1.4"); or {"skip": "reason"} for a fix no wave verifies, listed under excluded. check: optional one-line 'what to check', defaulting to the closing issue's title. scripts/walkthrough/fixes-since.mjs reads it and lists every relevant PR it cannot place. A PR gets one line in one wave: when it closes several mapped issues, the lowest-numbered issue's entry is the one used, so that entry's check also carries what the others need.
